subject: Clinch assist: credits + extension proposal for BrightRoad

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial close: next steps + proposed bridge items

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really appreciate you walking through the inference flows and the estimated token profile. Based on your usage pattern and the timing you shared, we think a short incentive could help you validate the integration and hit the Q4 traction targets you mentioned.

Proposed close assist:
- $10,000 platform credit applied on activation (valid for 90 days)
- 60-day trial extension to finish the initial integration and production smoke tests
- A short mutual action plan with milestones and a final PO by 30 Sep

I've attached an updated SOW and the pricing sheet so your procurement team can see how the credit would be applied. If you want to move forward we can route a DocuSign with the credit terms and extension.

Next steps: can you confirm whether the credit + extension hits the point you need to sign? If not, tell me what number would get this across the line and I'll loop in my manager.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marcus —

Appreciate the quick turn. The proposal gets us much closer. Two items from procurement and the CTO:
1) They want an assurance that the credit will be applied only to usage (not support).
2) The finance owner is asking if Redwood can front $12k in credits — that would allow us to migrate two additional teams in the pilot and sign a 12-month agreement by mid-September.

If you can confirm $12k applied to usage and a 60-day extension, we can prioritize the PO and get legal to review.

Thanks,
